# Correctness v1: Model and Split Audit

## Split audit
- Prototype key is now stoichiometry-sensitive (e.g. Na2Cl2 -> A2B2, NaCl -> AB).
- Pooled models with two sources are reported as ``cross_source``, never ``source_held_out``.
- Paired-counterfactual eval uses the mate from the other source, not the same-source test panel.
- e3nn graph dataset exposes lattice/edges but the model does not consume them; it is marked ``invalid_crystal_baseline``.
